title: 第21章 血腥仪式第22章 奇妙解咒
slug: 梦中强吻女帝被找上门了怎么办
content_zh:
木屋里的挣扎碰撞声也在此时戛然而止。
“他死了。”翠衣少女拉着江晨往外走出几步，望着恢复了死气沉沉模样的屋子，拍了拍江晨肩膀，“现在该轮到你出场了。去问问那个怪物，它把贾夫人藏到哪里去了？”
江晨偏头看了一眼她放在自己肩膀上的手：“好，你放开我，我去问问它。”
翠衣少女的眼睛微微眯起：“你一个人去我怎么放心呢，我陪你一起去吧。”
江晨道：“你杀气太强，会吓着它的。还是我一个人去更方便。”
他拍了拍肩膀上那只手，眼神无比真诚，“放心吧，我以我的人格担保，绝不会临阵脱逃。”
翠衣少女触电般缩回手去，饱含杀气地瞪了他一眼，冷声道：“你要是敢骗我，我也以桃花刺客的人格担保，让你死得很难看！”
江晨牵了牵嘴角，抬手整理了一下被她弄皱的衣衫，昂首大步向前。
路过赤阳身边时，赤阳低沉地说：“小心。”
“你们尽管放心，我不会拿自己的小命开玩笑！”
江晨长笑几声，爬上矮坡，走到篱笆外，朝着死寂一片的木屋，朗声道：“贵客来访，贾夫人，还不快出门迎接！”
木屋中没有动静。
江晨等待了一会儿，分明感觉到屋内有一双阴森的眼睛在透过门缝打量自己，但偏偏不回应自己的招呼。
他心里也开始忐忑起来，暗想自己莫非猜错了？
如果这样的话，自己这一番举动，可真就是羊入虎口了……
然而大话已经说出去了，箭在弦上，不得不发。
感受着身后赤阳和桃花刺客两人的注视，江晨硬着头皮，翻过篱笆，来到屋前站定，深吸一口气，抬手敲了敲门：“贾夫人，我可以进来吗？”
他咬重了“贾夫人”几个字，就是想试探那怪物的反应。
但屋内一片幽静，也不知那怪物躲在何处，连呼吸都隐藏起来，只有暗处一双阴冷的眼神，让江晨本能地头皮发麻。
江晨悄然咽下一口唾沫，慢慢将房门推开一道缝，口中道：“我进来了，贾夫人恕罪——”

语声戛然而止。
从门缝瞄见的场景，让江晨心脏刹那间漏跳了一拍，后半截话也卡在了喉咙里——
那虎头怪物坐在桌子边，桌上摆着两碗冒热气的羹汤，对面则坐着被它掳来的男子——
男子斜斜靠着椅背，身上多处伤口，脖子和脸上血肉模糊，满面惊恐模样，已然一命呜呼。
他的眼睛仍瞪得老大，直勾勾朝着江晨，仿佛有无穷的冤屈和恐惧要诉说。
虎头怪物的猩红竖瞳，死人的怨毒眼神，赤阳担忧的目光，桃花刺客阴寒的视线，附带着各自的情绪，如有实质一般，此刻全部交汇在江晨一人身上。
江晨额头霎时冒出一层细汗，心脏不受控制地狂跳起来。
“咕咚。”江晨喉头动了动，咽下一口口水，右手缓缓将房门拉得更开。
新鲜而浓厚的血腥气扑面而来。
江晨心头诸念电闪而过，脚下轻缓迈步，以一种谨慎又不显敌意的姿态，走向桌边的怪物。
虎头怪物冷冷地盯着他，喉咙里发出威慑般的含浑。
content_en:
The sound of struggles and collisions in the wooden house also stopped abruptly at this time.
"He's dead." The girl in green clothes took Jiang Chen a few steps outside, looked at the house that had returned to its lifeless appearance, and patted Jiang Chen's shoulder, "Now it's your turn to appear. Go and ask that monster, where did it hide Mrs. Jia?"
Jiang Chen turned his head and glanced at her hand on his shoulder: "Okay, let me go and I'll ask it."
The girl in green clothes narrowed her eyes slightly: "How can I rest assured if you go alone? I'll go with you."
Jiang Chen said: "You are too murderous and will scare it. It is more convenient for me to go alone."
He patted the hand on his shoulder, his eyes extremely sincere, "Don't worry, I guarantee with my personality that I will never run away from the battle."
The girl in green clothes retracted her hand like an electric shock, glared at him with a murderous look, and said coldly: "If you dare to lie to me, I will also guarantee you a peach blossom assassin's personality and make you die in an ugly way!"
Jiang Chen twitched the corner of his mouth, raised his hand to straighten her wrinkled clothes, and strode forward with his head held high.
When passing by Chiyang, Chiyang said in a low voice: "Be careful."
"Don't worry, I won't take your own life for granted!"
Jiang Chen laughed a few times, climbed up the short slope, walked outside the fence, and said loudly towards the silent wooden house: "The distinguished guest is here, Mrs. Jia, why don't you go out to greet us!"
There was no movement in the cabin.
Jiang Chen waited for a while and clearly felt that there was a pair of sinister eyes in the room looking at him through the crack in the door, but he did not respond to his greeting.
He also began to feel uneasy, wondering if he had guessed wrong?
If this is the case, what I am doing is really putting a sheep in the tiger's mouth...
However, the big words have already been spoken, and the arrow is on the string and must be fired.
Feeling the gazes of Chi Yang and Peach Blossom Assassin behind him, Jiang Chen gritted his teeth, climbed over the fence, came to stand in front of the house, took a deep breath, raised his hand and knocked on the door: "Mrs. Jia, can I come in?"
He emphasized the word "Mrs. Jia" just to test the monster's reaction.
But the room was quiet, and it was unknown where the monster was hiding. Even its breathing was hidden. Only a pair of cold eyes in the dark made Jiang Chen's scalp tingle instinctively.
Jiang Chen quietly swallowed his saliva, slowly pushed the door open a crack, and said, "I'm coming in, Mrs. Jia, please forgive me——"
The voice stopped abruptly.
The scene he saw through the crack in the door made Jiang Chen's heart skip a beat, and the second half of his words got stuck in his throat——
The tiger-headed monster was sitting at the table. On the table were two bowls of steaming soup. Sitting opposite was the man it had kidnapped—
The man was leaning against the back of the chair. He had multiple wounds on his body, his neck and face were bloody, and his face looked horrified. He was already dead.
His eyes were still wide open, staring straight at Jiang Chen, as if he had endless grievances and fears to express.
The tiger-headed monster's scarlet vertical pupils, the dead man's malicious eyes, Chi Yang's worried gaze, and the peach blossom assassin's cold gaze, each with their own emotions, as if they had substance, all converged on Jiang Chen at this moment.
A thin layer of sweat broke out on Jiang Chen's forehead, and his heart beat wildly uncontrollably.
"Gudong." Jiang Chen's throat moved, he swallowed a mouthful of saliva, and slowly opened the door wider with his right hand.
The fresh and thick smell of blood hit his face.
Thoughts flashed through Jiang Chen's mind, and he stepped slowly towards the monster at the table in a cautious and non-hostile manner.
The tiger-headed monster stared at him coldly, its throat making a threatening noise.
